definitions.name: integrated_classification
definitions.description: Integrated contig + MAG classification: assembly, viral/plasmid partition via geNomad, bacterial binning (SemiBin2 + MetaBAT2 + Binette + CheckM2), and GTDB-Tk taxonomy on MIMAG-passing bins. v1 minimum; contig fallback, plasmid typing, and per-contig TSV merge are deferred.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Input .csv file (samplesheet). Supports an optional `biome` column (between `sample` and `fastq_1`) used to pick the SemiBin2 pretrained model; defaults to `global` when empty.

parameters.name: contigs_dir
parameters.description: Contigs (DIRECTORY: optional). Folder containing SAMPLE_ID.contigs.fa.gz files; skips reassembly when provided.

parameters.name: chromosome_dir
parameters.description: Chromosome partition (DIRECTORY: optional). Folder containing SAMPLE_ID.chromosome.fna.gz files produced by a prior GENOMAD_EXTRACT_CHROMOSOME step. When provided, skips the entire VIRAL_DETECTION subworkflow (geNomad + CheckV passes + chromosome extraction). WARNING: does not check geNomad parameter consistency — re-run VIRAL_DETECTION instead of reusing if FDR thresholds or score calibration have changed.

parameters.name: mmseqs_taxonomy_db
parameters.description: Path to a pre-built MMseqs2 taxonomy database (e.g. GTDB built via `mmseqs databases GTDB <out> <tmp>`). Used for contig-level taxonomy fallback on the post-Binette unbinned set. Required for the per-contig classification TSV step. Typically set globally in ~/.metagear/metagear.config instead of per-invocation.

parameters.name: viral_ids_dir
parameters.description: Viral contig IDs directory (DIRECTORY: optional). Folder containing SAMPLE_ID_viral_ids_to_keep.txt files produced by a prior viral_analysis run (MERGE_TABLES output). Lets the per-contig TSV classify virus contigs even when --chromosome_dir bypassed VIRAL_DETECTION. Auto-discovered by --reuse-outputs.

parameters.name: plasmid_ids_dir
parameters.description: Plasmid contig IDs directory (DIRECTORY: optional). Folder containing SAMPLE_ID_plasmid_ids_to_keep.txt files. Same pattern as --viral_ids_dir.

definitions.name: cohort_dereplication
definitions.description: Cohort-level MAG dereplication and taxonomy assignment: dRep (skani backend) on per-sample Binette bins, GTDB-Tk on cluster representatives, coverm-genome MAG×sample abundance, and back-fill of integrated_classification's per-contig TSV with cohort lineage. Builds on a prior `integrated_classification` run; reads its bin and per-contig outputs from disk.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Input .csv file (samplesheet). Same shape as integrated_classification — the samplesheet is needed because abundance back-mapping uses the per-sample reads.

parameters.name: bins_dir
parameters.description: Per-sample Binette outputs (DIRECTORY). Points at integrated_classification's `binning/binette/` parent directory. The subworkflow tolerates both the current nested `<sample>/<sample>/final_bins/...` layout (Binette emits a `${meta.id}/` prefix dir that the publishDir adds another sample dir on top of) and a future flattened `<sample>/final_bins/...` layout.

parameters.name: per_contig_tsv_dir
parameters.description: Per-contig classification TSV directory (DIRECTORY). Points at integrated_classification's `per_contig/` output (flat layout: `<sample>.contigs.tsv`). Required for the per-contig TSV enrichment step.

parameters.name: gtdb_tk_db
parameters.description: Path to a GTDB-Tk database (R220 or compatible). Typically set globally in ~/.metagear/metagear.config; this parameter exists so a user can point at an alternate release per-invocation.
